_comment: Named capture scenes for perf_capture.py (--scene). Arguments follow scripts/phase2-profile.ps1 (Get-ScenarioArguments, Get-PortalSceneArguments) so a capture and a baseline run see the same scene. {assets} is the converted asset folder (--assets), {repo} this checkout, {scratch} a scratch folder. Each scene also gets the benchmark-window and acceptance flags below; profiler runs are TEST runs and report nothing as a result.

synthetic.about: 250,000 synthetic instances, no world data: render-thread and GPU stress

dense.about: Riverwood, about 2,900 references within two cells

lod-far.about: high vantage over Riverwood looking up the valley: terrain LOD to the horizon

portal-heavy.about: standing view with one open portal view on screen (Sven's House door)

portal-door-tour.about: Riverwood demo door tour, two doors: approach, crossing and the way back
